description: Autocomplete against an AutoSugges reference list (countries, NAICS, airports, currencies, ...). Returns the ranked, bounded suggestions for ONE query; it cannot enumerate a list. The publishable key (server env) decides which list is searched.

limit.description: Max suggestions; capped by the list policy.

list.description: Informational list name or slug. The configured key selects the list.

locale.description: BCP-47 tag for display values, e.g. "fr".

parent.description: Item id of a parent (hierarchical lists only), to restrict to its descendants.

query.description: Text typed so far; at least 2 characters.

name: search_list
